name: 数据库备份策略综合诊断
description: 数据库备份策略设计涉及备份类型选择（全量/增量/归档）、频率、保留策略、备份验证和恢复测试。常见问题包括备份窗口超时、备份链断裂、retention policy 配置不当、备份未验证。

skip_when.desc: 开发测试环境且无备份要求
使用存储级快照备份替代

root_causes.name: 备份策略缺失或不完整
root_causes.desc: 没有定期备份、缺少归档备份、或只有全备没有增量。RPO/RTO 无法满足。

root_causes.name: 备份窗口不足导致备份超时
root_causes.desc: 全备数据量大、I/O 不足、或并行度不当，备份无法在窗口内完成。

root_causes.name: 备份链断裂导致无法恢复
root_causes.desc: 增量备份的基础全备被清理、归档日志缺失、或 controlfile 备份过期。

root_causes.name: retention policy 配置不当
root_causes.desc: REDUNDANCY 或 RECOVERY WINDOW 不合理，保留过多浪费空间或过少无法恢复。

root_causes.name: 备份未验证
root_causes.desc: 备份看似成功但从未做恢复测试。RMAN VALIDATE 或实际恢复测试未执行。

oltp.desc: OLTP 备份窗口短（4h），建议增量合并策略

olap.desc: OLAP 数据量大但变更集中

step1_check_backup_history.desc: 检查最近备份执行情况
step1_check_backup_history.sql: SELECT session_key, start_time, end_time, status, input_type, ROUND(elapsed_seconds/3600, 2) elapsed_hours, ROUND(input_bytes/1024/1024/1024, 2) input_gb, ROUND(output_bytes/1024/1024/1024, 2) output_gb, compression_ratio FROM v$rman_backup_job_details WHERE start_time > SYSDATE - 7 ORDER BY start_time DESC

step2_check_retention_policy.sql: SELECT * FROM v$rman_configuration WHERE name LIKE '%RETENTION%'

step3_check_backup_completeness.desc: 检查各数据文件最近备份时间
step3_check_backup_completeness.sql: SELECT file#, name, ROUND(SYSDATE - MAX(completion_time), 1) days_since_backup FROM v$datafile f LEFT JOIN v$backup_datafile b ON f.file# = b.file# GROUP BY file#, name ORDER BY days_since_backup DESC

step4_check_archivelog_backup.desc: 检查归档日志备份状态
step4_check_archivelog_backup.sql: SELECT TRUNC(completion_time) day, COUNT(*) archived, SUM(CASE WHEN backed_up = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) backed_up FROM v$archived_log WHERE completion_time > SYSDATE - 7 GROUP BY TRUNC(completion_time) ORDER BY day DESC
